validation.notes: Fault located in packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts:112, inside migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot(), which encoded the session-header cwd with `--${cwd.replace(/^[/\\]/, "").replace(/[/:]/g, "-")}--`. The replacement character class omitted the backslash, so Windows drive-letter and UNC cwds produced directories containing literal backslashes (e.g. `--C-\Users\dev\project--` instead of `--C--Users-dev-project--`), migrating sessions to the wrong directory. The one-line repair adds `\\` to the class, matching the canonical encoders already used by packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts:592 and packages/agent/src/harness/session/jsonl/repo.ts:37 (remove exactly one leading slash/backslash, then map every slash, backslash and colon to '-'). No other production change was needed: the function already ignores unparsable/non-session headers via try/catch plus `header.type !== "session" || !header.cwd`, moves files with renameSync so session bytes are preserved verbatim, skips when the destination path already exists (`if (existsSync(newPath)) continue;`), and is idempotent on repeated runs because migrated files leave the agent root. `.prale-eval/regression.mjs` loads the real migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot() through `.prale-eval/subject.mjs` createGraph() with self-written boundary fakes for ./config.ts, ./core/keybindings.ts, ./utils/text.ts and chalk (builtin fs/path are real), and asserts: (1) POSIX, drive-letter (backslash and forward-slash), lowercase drive, UNC `\\server\share\dir`, and trailing-separator cwds each migrate into exactly one directory whose name equals an independently implemented spec encoding, with identical bytes and the source removed; (2) canonical encoded shapes; (3) invalid headers (non-JSON, wrong type, missing cwd, blank first line) stay in the agent root with untouched bytes and create no sessions dir; (4) a valid session still migrates beside an invalid one; (5) a pre-existing destination file is never overwritten and its source is preserved; (6) a second run changes nothing (full-tree byte snapshot compare) for Windows and UNC sessions; (7) a missing agent root is a no-op. Verified locally: with the repaired line the command exits 0 with all assertions passing (also on a repeat run, no scratch residue), and with the original faulty line temporarily restored it exits 1 with AssertionError naming the wrong directory, e.g. `cwd "C:\\Users\\dev\\project" must migrate to sessions/--C--Users-dev-project--/session.jsonl (found ["--C-\\Users\\dev\\project--"])`. Limitation: the repository's vitest suites (e.g. packages/coding-agent/test/keybindings-migration.test.ts, config-value-migration.test.ts) could not be run because node_modules is not installed and dependencies may not be installed in this environment; the standalone Node 24 VM-module regression is the focused validation and exercises the production function directly.
